Four small steps onto the mark, and the joke lives in the three FREEZES between them, not in the steps. A sneak that moves continuously is just a slow walk; a sneak that stops dead every second to check whether anyone noticed is funny, and it is funny for free, because a freeze costs nothing to animate. Each step is a short eased whole-actor move of about 0.13 (they never cover much ground, which is the point), and each pause is a hard `parts` snap of the head looking one way and then the other while the body stays locked in its crouch.

The pauses are authored as GAPS — roughly 0.40s of no beats at all after each step, and 0.60s before the last one, the longest hold of the gag, because the beat before you get away with it is always the longest. No `duration` on the moves: a move here should settle and stay settled, and the gap is what carries the stillness.

Deliberately NOT animated: feet, tiptoes, arms. The crouched body angle plus a swivelling head IS the sneak in cutout terms — nobody draws toes in limited animation.

Every `parts` beat restates the body rotation along with the head, so a partial set can never silently drop the crouch. Pure tier 1-3: whole-actor moves, ad-hoc `body`/`head` transforms, two guaranteed sounds, three of the six faces. No clip, no pose, no new art. Position ends at dx 0.0 — on the mark, as rule 5 requires, since position survives to the end of the scene.

beats._comment: start the approach off the mark, repositioned while hidden so the audience never sees the jump. dx is an offset from the BOUND mark, so the four steps below walk -0.52 to 0.0 and end exactly where this character was staged.
the one face this whole gag is built on
low bed under the whole thing — it is what makes a freeze feel like suspense rather than a dropped frame
the sneak stance: body tipped forward, head pushed out ahead of it. Snaps into place — you ADOPT a sneak, you do not ease into one. The 0.30s of standing upright before it is the anticipation.
step 1. 0.13 of ground, eased so it starts and stops softly.
FREEZE ONE. Head snaps one way, body does not move, and then nothing happens at all for 0.40s. The nothing is the joke.
coast is clear — back to the stance
FREEZE TWO — head snaps the OTHER way. Alternating the direction is what stops three identical pauses reading as a stuck film.
FREEZE THREE, and the longest — 0.62s of absolutely nothing before the last step. This is the hold that makes the arrival land.
step 4 lands them ON the mark — the gag tidies its own position by arriving at zero rather than by undoing anything
straightens up all at once. Rest pose, and the release of every bit of tension the crouch was holding.
...one more look, just in case. The button is the relapse.
